name: infra-control-ui-handoff
description: Paquete de handoff de la UI de Infra Control (variante D · Pixel atardecer). React + TypeScript estricto.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && vite build --config vite.config.ts && node checks/build-service-worker.ts
scripts.verify: npm run tokens && npm run contract && npm test && npm run build
scripts.contract: tsc --ignoreConfig --noEmit --types node --strict --skipLibCheck --target ES2023 --module ESNext --moduleResolution bundler --allowImportingTsExtensions checks/contract-sync.ts
